notes: Audience profiles are estimates of each app's typical users across age, location, work, income and gender.
Each estimate cites the pages it rests on. Many are press coverage, company statements, filings or industry reports, not official statistics.
"Reported" means a source states the figure or audience directly. "Estimate" means it is our judgement from the cited source; the reason is shown.
Bank rows cover all of a bank's apps, so their profiles describe the bank's retail customer base.
Joining requirements are separate and can vary by product.
